A complete authentication system has been implemented in your Chat App, connecting the React frontend with the Node.js/Express backend and MongoDB.

Preview the live application here:
🔗 **[View Chat App Live](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/2c9ec92c-2e8e-49e8-82c1-cd23941127f6/d9fec2e49268347e4edae7e3/)**

---

### What Was Implemented

1. **User Registration & Login**:
   - [Register.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/pages/Register.jsx): Real-time password strength meter, custom avatar generator/preview, and validation.
   - [Login.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/pages/Login.jsx): Supports both username and email, password visibility toggle, remember session, and one-click demo credentials autofill.
   - Redirects unverified users automatically to the OTP verification screen.

2. **JWT Access & Refresh Tokens**:
   - Short-lived Access Token (15m) and long-lived Refresh Token (7d) configured in [User.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/models/User.js#L93-L124).
   - Route `POST /api/auth/refresh-token` for secure token rotation.
   - Automatic silent token refresh on 401 response in [apiClient.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/api/apiClient.js#L37-L95).

3. **Secure Password Hashing with Bcrypt**:
   - Passwords and OTP codes are hashed with `bcryptjs` (salt rounds: 10) in [User.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/models/User.js#L75-L84).
   - Secure verification comparison via instance methods.

4. **Email OTP Verification During Registration**:
   - Secure 6-digit numeric OTP generation with 10-minute expiry and brute-force attempt limits.
   - Dispatched via [emailService.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/utils/emailService.js) (supports SMTP or formatted console notification).
   - [VerifyOtp.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/pages/VerifyOtp.jsx): 6-digit auto-advancing input boxes, full paste support, 60s countdown timer, and resend OTP functionality.

5. **Forgot & Reset Password**:
   - [ForgotPassword.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/pages/ForgotPassword.jsx): Requests 6-digit reset code via email.
   - [ResetPassword.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/pages/ResetPassword.jsx): Verifies OTP, updates password with bcrypt, revokes stale refresh tokens, and signs the user in.

6. **Logout Functionality**:
   - Route `POST /api/auth/logout` invalidates stored refresh tokens in MongoDB and marks the user's status as `offline`.
   - Cleans up client-side `localStorage` tokens and Socket.IO connections.

7. **Protected Routes & Persistent Login**:
   - [ProtectedRoute.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/components/ProtectedRoute.jsx) guards chat rooms and redirects unauthenticated users to `/login`.
   - [PublicRoute.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/components/PublicRoute.jsx) redirects authenticated users to `/chat`.
   - [AuthContext.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/context/AuthContext.jsx) restores user sessions on page reload via `/api/auth/me`.

8. **Form Validation & Error Handling**:
   - Server-side validation middlewares in [validationMiddleware.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/middlewares/validationMiddleware.js).
   - Stricter rate-limiting for auth & OTP routes in [rateLimiter.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/middlewares/rateLimiter.js).

9. **Backend Server & MongoDB Integration**:
   - [server.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/server.js) with Express, Socket.IO, Helmet, CORS, and compression.
   - Auto-detecting MongoDB connector in [db.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/config/db.js) with in-memory MongoDB fallback.
   - **12/12 Automated Integration Tests Passed** in [auth.test.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/tests/auth.test.js).

A complete real-time messaging system using **Socket.IO**, **MongoDB**, **Express**, and **React** has been implemented in your Chat App.

Preview the live application here:
🔗 **[View Chat App Live](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/2c9ec92c-2e8e-49e8-82c1-cd23941127f6/d9fec2e49268347e4edae7e3/)**

---

### What Was Implemented

1. **Instant Message Sending and Receiving (Socket.IO)**:
   - Client sends messages via `socket.emit('message:send', ...)` with callback acknowledgments, saving to MongoDB and broadcasting `message:received` to the room in real time.
   - Built with dual transport support (WebSocket with polling fallback) and automatic reconnection handling in [SocketContext.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/context/SocketContext.jsx) and [server.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/server.js#L140-L245).

2. **One-to-One Private Chat**:
   - Dynamic 1-on-1 conversations created between users via `POST /api/rooms` with `{ type: 'direct', recipientId }` in [roomController.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/controllers/roomController.js#L44-L83).
   - Dedicated direct conversation views displaying recipient's live presence, avatar, and last-seen activity.

3. **Online / Offline User Presence Status**:
   - Sockets track connected sessions per user (`onlineUserSockets` map) in [server.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/server.js#L140-L165).
   - Real-time `user:status` events broadcast online/offline transitions to all connected peers.
   - Initial `users:online_list` event syncs active users immediately upon connection.

4. **Typing Indicators**:
   - Composer emits debounced `typing:start` on keystroke and `typing:stop` after 2.5s of inactivity.
   - Broadcasts `typing:status` to active room participants with animated bouncing dots ("Alex is typing...").

5. **Sent, Delivered and Read Receipts**:
   - **Pending**: Animated clock spinner (optimistic UI)
   - **Sent (✓)**: Single gray checkmark when saved to MongoDB
   - **Delivered (✓✓)**: Double gray checkmarks when recipient's socket receives or fetches message
   - **Read (✓✓)**: Double bright cyan/blue checkmarks when recipient opens room, emitted via `message:read` and `POST /api/messages/room/:roomId/read`.

6. **Message Timestamps & Calendar Date Dividers**:
   - [dateUtils.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/utils/dateUtils.js): Formats time ("11:42 AM"), relative last-seen status ("Active now", "Active 5m ago"), and sticky calendar day dividers ("Today", "Yesterday", "Nov 14, 2026").

7. **Chat History from MongoDB**:
   - [messageController.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/controllers/messageController.js#L6-L59): Fetches message history populated with sender information, avatars, and reactions.

8. **Message Pagination & Lazy Loading**:
   - Cursor-based pagination supporting `limit` and `before` timestamp cursors.
   - [ChatApp.jsx](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/pages/ChatApp.jsx#L290-L300): Infinite scroll-up detection that loads older messages automatically while maintaining exact scroll position without jumps.

9. **Real-Time Notifications & Sound**:
   - Floating in-app notification toasts appear when receiving messages from background channels/conversations.
   - [sound.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/client/src/utils/sound.js): Synthesizes a soft, pleasant chime using the HTML5 Web Audio API (zero external MP3 dependencies).
   - Unread message counter pills in the sidebar.

10. **Optimistic UI with Error Recovery**:
    - Messages render immediately in the stream with `status: 'pending'`.
    - Automatically updates to `sent` upon server acknowledgment.
    - If sending fails, marks as `failed` with a one-click "Retry" action.

---

### Automated Test Verification
Both integration suites (19 tests) passed:
- **Authentication & Security Suite**: 12/12 passing
- **Real-Time Messaging & Socket.IO Suite**: 7/7 passing in [realtime.test.js](https://github.com/Ashishsahu0107/my-project/blob/main/server/tests/realtime.test.js)
